mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals severe labor market distress that triggers corporate earnings revisions downward, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 9.0% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in federal funds rate and increase in CPIAUCSL signals policy response to inflation, causing temporary market correction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL increase fails to predict negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 130,000 thousand signals worsening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.5%), PAYEMS decline below 130000.0 fails to predict negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 500.0 thousand units signals contraction in residential construction, reducing consumer wealth and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where HOUST is below 500.0 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 95.0 indicates expanding manufacturing output, correlating with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to predict positive 60-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a rise in federal funds rate above 0.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), FEDFUNDS rise above 0.5% fails to predict negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market crisis, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE increase and PAYEMS decline fails to predict negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 1-year rolling window.
